subject: Request: Launch stipend window extension for AtomLens cohort shift
messages:
From: Elias Chen <elias@atomlens.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch stipend window — request to preserve credits after cohort move

Hi Naomi,

Quick context: our accelerator cohort start date was postponed by two weeks due to venue logistics. We were approved for the Founder Launch stipend last month, but the activation window in the dashboard closed before our new cohort kick-off. The credit window closed on May 30th and the new cohort starts June 16th.

Is there a way to keep the stipend active until June 30th so our cohort can onboard and run the initial experiments? We expect ~120k tokens in the first two weeks (mostly embeddings + batch evals) — I've attached a small usage snapshot and the cohort calendar.

We're on the Standard Startup package (AtomLens / account ID AL-778). I can loop in procurement if you need an LOA. Appreciate any flexibility — this stipend makes the difference for a few of our teams.

Thanks,
Elias Chen
Co-founder, AtomLens
elias@atomlens.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: sandbox-usage-report.csv

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elias Chen <elias@atomlens.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch stipend window — request to preserve credits after cohort move

Hi Elias — thanks for the quick note and the usage snapshot. I can take a look but will need a couple of things to move this through:

- Confirm which teams will consume the stipend and a rough split (embeddings vs. generation).
- Any reason the billing/account admin couldn't request a one-time voucher in HubSpot (we typically require a request from an admin).
- Target extension date you want (you mentioned June 30 — that seems reasonable if consumption is within the expected range).

Ben, tagging you for credit policy guidance and whether we can accommodate a staggered activation or an exception. If this looks like above-and-beyond ( >200k tokens or multiple accounts), we'll need to escalate to Marissa for approval.

Elias — can you reply with the team split and confirm the account admin? If you prefer, I can take the LOA/contract channel and draft a short term-sheet to formalize the extension and any usage guardrails.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Growth, Redwood Inference
aomi@redwood.ai

From: Elias Chen <elias@atomlens.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@atomlens.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch stipend window — request to preserve credits after cohort move

Thanks Naomi — quick answers below:

- Teams: three small teams (Founders A, B, C). Expected split: 60% embeddings (batch offline indexing), 40% generation (prompt design & evaluation).
- Account admin: accounts@atomlens.ai (you can send any formal requests there).
- Extension target: June 30 is perfect. If we need up to July 7 because onboarding slips again, that would be a helpful buffer.

I've re-attached the usage CSV and added a short proposed timeline in the body. Let me know if a term sheet makes this easier — we'd sign a short one-page amendment committing to attribution & a short case study post-cohort.

Onward,
Elias

---Quoted attachment: sandbox-usage-report.csv---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Jun 2028 10:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Launch stipend window — AtomLens extension request (decision needed)

Marissa / Ben — forwarding AtomLens' request. Summary: Founder Launch stipend expired May 30; cohort moved to Jun 16. They ask for an extension to Jun 30 (or max Jul 7). Expected consumption ~120k tokens (60/40 split). They offer a short case study in exchange and can sign a one-page amendment.

Questions for approvals:
- Can we auto-extend stipend windows for cohort shifts up to 7 days with no finance impact?
- If we grant an extension >30 days after expiry, do we treat it as a new promo (i.e., flag as promotional credit) that needs manual accounting?
- If we can't extend the stipend itself, can we offer a companion 15% first-month credit on Dedicated conversion to cover overflow?

Ben — any quick policy guidance? Marissa — this might be fine as a one-off; I suggest we tie it to a simple term-sheet (one page) and require the case study commitment. I'll draft the term sheet if you approve.

Thanks,
Naomi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Launch stipend window — AtomLens extension request (decision needed)

Naomi / Ben — approve as a one-time exception with these constraints:

- Grant extension to Jul 7 (to cover the "buffer") but mark as promotional stipend and tag to DL-2028-0192 for finance reconciliation.
- Cap the extended stipend at 150k tokens (to limit exposure).
- Require the one-page case study / attribution within 45 days post-cohort; include a short quote and a usage summary.
- If consumption exceeds the cap, offer a 15% credit on the first Dedicated invoice as a make-good (requires customer opt-in).

Ben: please create the promo credit record and flag for accounting. Naomi: feel free to send the one-page term-sheet and the DocuSign link to Elias; include the usage cap and the make-good path.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Elias Chen <elias@atomlens.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch stipend window — request to preserve credits after cohort move (approved)

Hi Elias — good news: we can approve a one-time extension. Terms below (short form):

- Extension window: credits preserved and active through 2028-07-07.
- Cap: 150,000 tokens total (60/40 split noted).
- If usage exceeds 150k, we will offer a 15% credit on the first Dedicated invoice as a make-good; to receive that, please opt into the Dedicated conversion offer in your account settings.
- Requirement: one-page case study / short attribution + usage summary within 45 days after cohort start.

I've created the promo record and attached a draft term-sheet. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/AX-9921-atomlens-extension (link). Attachments: term-sheet-proposal.pdf. Ben has been looped in for accounting and will follow up on the credit record.

If all good, I'll finalize in HubSpot and mark the promo as applied to account AL-778.

Best of luck with the cohort — excited to see what AtomLens ships.
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Growth, Redwood Inference
aomi@redwood.ai

Attachments: term-sheet-proposal.pdf
